categories.main_business_segments: Franklin Resources operates as a global investment management organization with one operating segment: investment management and related services. The company provides investment management services through multiple specialist investment managers operating under brand names including Franklin, Templeton, Legg Mason, Putnam, ClearBridge Investments, and others. Services include management of sponsored funds, institutional and high-net-worth separate accounts, retail separately managed account programs, sub-advised products, and related services such as fund administration, sales and distribution, and shareholder servicing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs fundamental investment research and valuation analyses, including original economic, political, industry and company research. Core methodologies include portfolio management across multiple asset classes (equity, fixed income, alternatives, multi-asset, and cash management), quantitative asset management, and various investment strategies such as value investing, growth investing, smart beta, and thematic investments. The company utilizes proprietary technology platforms for investment management, trading systems, financial accounting, and shareholder servicing, with ongoing investments in artificial intelligence and process automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Franklin serves retail, institutional, and high-net-worth investors globally, including individual investors, institutional investors, sovereign wealth funds, defined benefit and contribution plans, endowments and charitable foundations, healthcare systems, and insurance companies. The company distributes products through direct channels to investors and through financial intermediaries including broker-dealers, banks, investment advisers, and financial institutions. Primary end markets include U.S. and international markets across equity, fixed income, alternative, and multi-asset investment categories.
categories.geographic_coverage: Franklin operates globally with significant presence in the United States, Europe (including Luxembourg, Ireland, and the United Kingdom), Asia-Pacific (including Australia, Hong Kong, Japan, Singapore, and India), Latin America, Canada, and the Middle East. As of September 30, 2024, the company operated offices in over 30 countries. U.S. AUM represented $1,177.1 billion (70% of total), while international AUM represented $501.5 billion (30% of total), including Europe, Middle East and Africa ($209.1 billion), Asia-Pacific ($178.0 billion), and Americas excluding U.S. ($114.4 billion).
categories.supply_chain_position: Franklin operates as a midstream and downstream participant in the investment management supply chain. The company manages investment products and provides advisory services directly to end investors and through intermediaries. Franklin outsources various administration, technology, transfer agency, and other services to third-party providers, and relies on financial intermediaries for distribution. The company also acts as a general partner for various investment partnerships and manages alternative investment vehicles including private equity, hedge funds, and real estate funds.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include investment excellence and long-term investment performance, innovation to meet evolving client goals, building strong partnerships through superior client service, and developing technology solutions including artificial intelligence and process automation. The company is focused on expanding its alternative and multi-asset capabilities, enhancing digital wealth and distribution tools, addressing emerging markets such as China and India, and integrating recent acquisitions including Putnam Investments. R&D initiatives include selection of third-party technology solutions to unify investment management platforms across asset classes and reduce operational complexity.
categories.revenue_model: Franklin generates revenues primarily through investment management fees (80.4% of operating revenues in fiscal 2024), which are calculated as a percentage of assets under management and vary by asset class and service type. Additional revenue streams include sales and distribution fees (16.3% of operating revenues), earned from upfront sales commissions and ongoing distribution fees; shareholder servicing fees (2.7% of operating revenues), based on contractual margins or percentage of AUM; and other fees (0.5% of operating revenues). Performance fees are also earned on certain alternative products. The company pays substantially all sales and distribution fees to financial intermediaries that sell its funds.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Franklin competes with numerous investment management companies, securities brokerage and investment banking firms, insurance companies, banks, hedge fund firms, and other financial management institutions. The company believes it is one of the more widely diversified investment management firms based in the U.S., with competitive advantages from its economic and geographic diversity, broad product mix, global presence, and specialist investment managers. Competitors include larger firms with greater financial resources and broader distribution channels. Competition is based on investment performance, product offerings, service quality, distribution relationships, fees, and reputation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Franklin is a large-cap investment management company with total assets under management of $1,678.6 billion as of September 30, 2024, representing 22% growth from $1,374.2 billion at September 30, 2023. Operating revenues for fiscal year 2024 were $8,478.0 million (8% increase from $7,849.4 million in fiscal 2023). Net income attributable to Franklin Resources was $464.8 million in fiscal 2024 (47% decrease from $882.8 million in fiscal 2023), with diluted earnings per share of $0.85 (51% decrease from $1.72 in fiscal 2023). The company employed approximately 10,200 employees as of September 30, 2024, and maintains a market capitalization of approximately $8.7 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Franklin's value proposition centers on investment management expertise, wealth management solutions, and technology-enabled services to help clients achieve better outcomes. The company emphasizes long-term investment performance, offering a broad range of strategies across diverse asset classes with specialized expertise through its multiple brand-name investment managers. Differentiation includes over 75 years of investment management experience, globally diversified business model, specialist investment managers with deep expertise in specific asset classes and strategies, commitment to ESG and sustainable investing, and comprehensive technology solutions. The company leverages its Franklin Templeton brand, which is recognized for trust and confidence in the industry.
